name: TD SYNNEX
summary:
TD SYNNEX provides global technology distribution, cloud enablement, and IT solutions aggregation across enterprise infrastructure, security, cloud, and modern platform environments.

Together, we support organisations with access to modern infrastructure and platform technologies through combined commercial, enablement, and partner delivery capabilities. Through this partnership, we help customers accelerate technology adoption across cloud-native and enterprise infrastructure environments.
overview:
TD SYNNEX works with vendors, partners, and enterprise customers to deliver technology solutions across cloud, cybersecurity, datacentre, networking, and modern infrastructure platforms.

Together, we help organisations access and adopt modern platform technologies across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises infrastructure. Through combined commercial alignment, technical enablement, and partner collaboration, we support customers across Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, platform modernisation, automation, and operational transformation initiatives.

Our focus is on helping organisations navigate modern infrastructure technologies with confidence while supporting long-term platform capability and operational maturity.

As the partnership continues to evolve, we are expanding opportunities around platform delivery, technical enablement, and operational support across cloud-native environments.
